logExportCommand: process == "coreaudiod" OR eventMessage CONTAINS "HALC_" OR eventMessage CONTAINS "HALS_"
method: Match each trace by its unique exported attachment filename; the two direct-native controls have the same buffer-count identity. Associate CoreAudio events using raw mach host ticks, not UTC timestamps. Clip positive native skipped intervals to each known input region.
limits: No claim of physical speaker output or virtual-device/guest/host scheduler root cause. Render elapsed includes preemption and excludes other HAL graph work; audio host timestamp is not a HAL deadline. The CoreAudio projection uses attachment timestamps plus/minus 30 seconds and explicit message terms; it is not a complete system-log inventory.
